analysis_comparison: All grouped map rewards, means, paired intervals, safety counts and final gate exactly match frozen analysis.

formulas.gate: Exactly one preselected primary; delta >= .01 AND paired lower > 0 AND zero deaths/invalid AND joint home/alive rate >= greedy - 1/256.
formulas.global_safety: Count home, alive and their intersection separately; preserve all deaths and away endings.
formulas.map_score: Mean across all three fixed training-seed arms for a single-policy group; one arm for ensemble/control.
formulas.paired: For sorted 256 maps, subtract same-map control reward; mean difference; 20,000 256-map samples with replacement, NumPy default_rng(612256); 2.5/97.5 percentiles.
formulas.selection: No final-stage reselection; all controls retained regardless of outcomes.

limits: This independent review reconstructs statistics and immutable metadata/audit bindings, not the physical trajectories. Worker full-controller, physics and policy audits remain separately retained.
Map-bootstrap inference is conditional on the six fixed trained policies; controls are contextual, no multiplicity-adjusted claim or training-seed generalization.
Final worlds are consumed; no tuning or new experiment is authorized. Submission-only next.
